tasks.title: The drive measures a red's base once and stops with red-at-base, not resume, when the base reproduces every failing case
tasks.description: Fixes F836. Root cause: every drive row in stage 2 k02/k03r has baseRed.verdict no-base ("no run of this gate is recorded at base ... on a clean tree"); no ledger row ever tested either base commit. At a27f8a56: base_red run-test-gate.py:596-641 only reads the ledger through _evidence_io.base_run 861-879 (same_head and tested_tree_clean); a task gate runs on HEAD plus the work, so its rows are dirty and no-base is the usual answer for any task. run-test-gate.py:5790-5797 computes base_reading only for failed measured --task runs; drive-phase.base_red_why 1319-1356 turns it into a clause; gate_red_decision 2535-2567 never branches on the verdict (gate-red-writer at 2549-2553, DECISIONS 732-735). Fix: on no-base/not-knowable, measure the red steps once per start in a detached worktree at HEAD (stamp-verification._build_throwaway 3286-3291 is the pattern) with `run-test-gate.py ... --record --tree <wt>` and no task id, then decide: base-only -> a new decision gate-red-base (block / rerun / owner commit over it with a reason, see base_red_lines 687-690) with a STEPS row and a DECISIONS entry. Compare by failing case per script (P157.2's reader), and by suite or case for derived steps - _base_step 560-572 matches by name and derived names carry suite lists (_affected_tests.py:1009, run-test-gate.py:2603). Stage-2 cost of this fault: 0.239 writer + 0.501 orchestrator over two runs.

tasks.title: The drive dispatches the task gate as a background step and decides from the recorded row, so the CLI's background-command limit cannot kill it into a second measurement
tasks.description: Fixes F838. In stage 2 k02 and k03r the orchestrator's `drive-phase.py next ... --task --signal` call carried no timeout and no run_in_background; the CLI moved it to the background after 120 s and killed it at about 708-720 s (durationMs 708384/708206), and the drive measured the whole gate again. At a27f8a56 the drive runs the task gate inline in gate_step 4573-4594 (task_gate 3311-3322, record_gate 3298-3308). Only the writer's run: line carries a background rule (WRITER_RULE drive-phase.py:475-476, held by sn4d ~10082). Mechanism: a dispatch step for the gate with a WRITER_RULE-shaped rule (every command already routes dispatch to background Bash; commands/phase.md has 2 B left under measure-context, so no command-doc bytes), the next call reuses the recorded verdict (reused_result ~2979, GATE VERDICT REUSED) - verify reuse holds on an identical tree digest - and a wait step for a launched gate with no row yet (like wait-writer 493-497). The CLI's 600 s cap is recorded at audit-task.py:5902 (_BASH_CALL_CAP_SECONDS).

add: tests/test_drive_phase.py: next on a task whose writer has exited prints a gate dispatch whose run: line is the run-test-gate argv with a background rule and runs no gate inline; the next call decides from the recorded row without measuring again; a gate killed mid-run prints a wait or rerun step, never a silent re-measure; every command doc that routes dispatch covers the gate step (sn4d-style)
